title: Stitch sampler

reference.source: Reference 11: embroidery sampler on white, 905 × 1181 px
reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: One twisted-thread capsule, 8 px wide with a lit crown and dark flanks, laid by five band generators on a 22.5 px grid in two threads, casting a 2 px shadow on white paper.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 905 × 1181 and every length scales with the canvas

pitch.does: Spacing of the stitch grid every band is laid on. Measured 22 to 23 px in every band.

thread.does: Diameter of the thread. Measured 8.2 px on the satin runs, 7.2 px on the chevrons.

twist.does: How much the lit crown and the body striation follow the 4.8 px twist of the bundle.

fuzz.does: Edge wobble and stray hairs within 3.5 px of each thread.

mix.does: Strength of the cluster field that hands a band's stitches to the other thread. 0 keeps each band one color.

bands.does: How many bands of the sampler are sewn, in order from the top.

needle.does: Length of the needle at the top right. 0 removes it and its loose thread.

shadow.does: Darkening of the paper under each thread, blurred 2.2 px and offset 2 px.

paper.does: Fine grain and 36 px mottle of the white. The reference paper is flat, so the default is 0.

typeSize.does: Cap size of the wordmark under the sampler.

seed.does: Re-rolls band heights, color clusters, tufts.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Pull
techniques.implementation: Satin run at 54°: the lit crown rides the 4.8 px twist, dark flanks either side

techniques.name: Grain
techniques.implementation: Packed bar: loops 6.4 px apart with a dark groove between, 96 % coverage

techniques.name: Edge
techniques.implementation: Tuft: loose ends splayed from the band edge at 55 % of the stitch width

pass_order: stitch list: band generators on the 22.5 px grid (satin runs at 54°, a packed bar whose loops sit 6.4 px apart, a couched lattice with cross knots, chevrons of 9.5 px amplitude in rows 15 px apart, herringbone), tufts at band ends, a needle with its loose loop
one color field (150 px) hands clusters of stitches to the second thread
rasterize each capsule in z order: coverage from the capsule distance, a 5.5 px twist moving the lit crown, dark flanks past 30 % of the radius, hairs within 3.5 px
needle body in steel over the threads
photographic softness: the thread layer blurred 0.6 px premultiplied; thread shadow: coverage blurred 2.2 px, offset 2 px, darkening the paper 6 %
paper: flat [246,246,246] as in the reference (grain optional); threads and type over it

measured.grid_pitch_px: autocorrelation peaks at 22 to 23 and 45 in satin, lattice, chevron and herringbone bands
measured.band_rows_y: satin 175 to 370, bar 385 to 410, lattice 470 to 540, chevron 540 to 600, herringbone 600 to 770, lattice 780 to 850, chevron 850 to 950
measured.rejected: a flat two-tone thread: the measured cross profile has three tones with the lit crown off center

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Blue and red palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: Bands are generated in the reference's order with the reference's heights; patches were placed with search.py on the default render, then fixed by hand on the matching stitch family.

limits: Benchmark 90.8 % mean. The packed bar scores lowest (contrast 65 %, histogram 73 %): the reference bar is a braid with crevices down to L 48 and lit loops up to L 247, the rebuild's grooves bottom out near L 70.

Satin and chevron autocorrelation (87 %, 80 %) miss because the rebuild's stitch spacing is a jittered 22.5 px grid and the reference's hand spacing drifts more; ink coverage in the satin patch (77 %, 74 %) depends on where the seeded red cluster falls.
The reference's red cross-hatch patch is a separate diagonal lattice laid over the satin; the rebuild clusters stitches of the second thread instead.
The wordmark in the reference is a fashion house; it is replaced by editable Mindgut copy in Archivo, so the type is not scored.
The reference paper is flat [246,246,246]; the thread layer is blurred 0.6 px for the photograph's softness, and the shadow is one blurred offset, not a lit model.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
This spec follows the controls: open it again, or leave it open, after changing them.
